scorecard.rationale: The Parkinson diet cohort recorded mango without a graded insomnia result. Other mango studies measured a sleep item or omitted sleep. Isolated myrcene altered barbiturate-induced sleep in animals, with opposite results under different schedules, and none of those comparisons administered raw mango. The exact clinical claim remains open. The 2008 Lagos market inventory lists insomnia alongside other intended uses for mango leaves, bark and root, with no symptom trajectory or mapping to a specific part. The 2022 survey attributes its 95 mango use reports to malaria and fever. Acute mango leaf extract trials measure wakeful activity and mood. The raw-fruit Parkinson insomnia effect remains unresolved.
